changelog: New: License Key Required — Starting with UltraGrab Pro v1.8.42, a valid Central License Key is required to use the application
Note: Earlier UltraGrab Pro releases continue to use their existing legacy activation system
Improved: License validation and application startup security
Fixed: An expired license can no longer be used by going offline — the app now stays locked until the license is renewed
Removed: The legacy Telegram Bot activation and launch tracking from this version
Improved: Uninstalling or reinstalling UltraGrab Pro keeps this device's license activation
Fixed: Reddit HLS video downloading and temporary fragment cleanup
Fixed: High-quality YouTube downloads restored — the best available source quality is used again
Fixed: Final merged output detection for Vimeo / Other platforms
Improved: Instagram public download handling and cookie fallback
Fixed: Public Facebook videos now download even when the saved browser session is logged out or stale
Fixed: Twitter/X videos with a separate audio track no longer show as failed after the download finishes
Added: Regression coverage for the updated download platforms
